name: Draftout 1.17.0
changelog:
**Minecraft 26.3**
- Draftout has now moved to Minecraft version 26.3!
- You must make a new instance and manually add the Draftout mod.
  - We are working on a modpack which will make updating easier in the future, but it's still being reviewed by Modrinth.
- Removed ALL allowed mods, except:
  - 'No Chat Restrictions'
  - 'No Telemetry'
  - (macOS only) 'retiNO'
  - (macOS only) 'Boundless Window'
  - (macOS only) 'CommandQMod'
  - We will announce new allowed mods as they get updated.
  - (Video Settings) Brightness slider range has been changed to 0-500%.

**Goals**
- Added goals:
  - Obtain Bucket of Sulfur Cube
  - Obtain Straw Bed
  - Obtain 64 Nametags
  - Obtain Coal Block
  - Sit in colored Cushion
  - Ignite a TNT Sulfur Cube
  - Ride Geyser
  - Die to Sulfur Cube
  - Fill Inventory with Mushroom Stew
  - Put a Bundle in a Bundle
- Updated goals:
  - Obtain every type of Mushroom -> Obtain 4 Unique Mushrooms (includes Shelf Mushroom)
  - Obtain 4 unique Saplings (includes Poplar Sapling)

**Gameplay**
- Standardized effects from food (hunger from Rotten Flesh and Chicken; poison from Poisonous Potato)
- Standardized damage from Iron Golem.

**Seeds**
- New seed type: Abandoned Camp (every variation can appear)
- Removed "Miscellaneous" seed type.
  - It was split into 3 seed types: Mansion, Ancient City & Pale Garden
  - Removed seed types: Trail Ruins, Mushroom biome, Old Growth Taiga biome
- Each seed type now has it's own %:
  - (16.3% each) Village, Shipwreck, Abandoned Camp, Pillager Outpost
  - (8.2% each) Desert Temple, Jungle Temple
  - (6.5%) Witch Hut
  - (4.9%) Mansion
  - (3.2%) Igloo
  - (1.6% each) Ancient City, Pale Garden
- Seedbank now contains over **200k seeds**
  - (Competitive) Seeds can no longer be played more than once.
  - Goals which require certain biomes (e.g. Warm Ocean, Jungle, Pale Garden) now also require a large surface area for these biomes (50+ chunks) near spawn.
  - Minimum spawn Y has been upped to 60.
    - This should reduce the number of cave spawns.
  - Lava Pools near spawn should be much more common (Lava Pool spawn locations were scouted during seedfinding).
    - Other surface Lava Pools are still 2x the Vanilla spawn rate.

**Replays**
- Replays are now recorded in all Quick Play matches.
- Replays are now recorded in Lobby matches if Lobby host has Supporter Tier 1+.
  - Lobby host can choose to have the replay private (only downloadable by match players) in Lobby settings.
- All replays are now stored for 3 days.

**Settings**
- Completed goals now use symbols (✔ for you and ✗ for opponents) for readability.
  - You can toggle between Symbols and Colors with a hotkey.
  - Colors have also been slightly modified.
- Supporters can choose which Supporter badge they want to display in Account tab.
- Added "Enable 'Preset' Slider" setting to Utility tab (can be used to disable the slider in Video Settings).

name: Draftout 1.16.1
changelog:
**Gameplay**
- Competitive queue should now be noticeably faster.
  - We are working on queue speed settings for future updates.
- Changed team colors to be more readable.
  - There is now a dark outline on completed goals, which should also help readability.
  - We will keep working on this to make it better.

**Bug Fixes**
- Fixed "Lock a Map using Cartography Table" goal not working correctly.
- Fixed "Teleport through Nether Portal using Ender Pearl" being available in non-Lobby games (it might come back soon!).
- Fixed Countdown setting being reset after board was rerolled.
- Fixed "Player is typing" showing up from previous games sometimes.
- Fixed being able to move in Quick Play during draft.
- Fixed typos & crashes.

name: Draftout 1.16.0
changelog:
**Supporter Tiers and Store**
- Visit https://draftout.paynow.store to support us and fund future events!
- Some features include:
  - More board color options
  - Select teams in Lobbies
  - Choose seed type in Lobbies
- Tiers are a **monthly subscription** and offer some cosmetics & Lobby features.
  - Tier 3 is priced highly because it will offer Tournament features (access to Live match API, spectator in Lobbies etc.)
  - It will (soon) include Lobby Spectator option and offer more tournament tools.
- You can now link your Discord account from Settings -> Account.
  - If you buy a Supporter Tier, you will get access to a new Supporter-only channel (#supporter-chat).

**Leaderboard reset & new ranks**
- Reset all Competitive ratings, leaderboards and added new ranks.
- Ratings now use the [Glicko 2](https://www.glicko.net/glicko/glicko2.pdf) system which rates you closer to your skill, faster. In general, elo gain/loss is way higher early on, than lower than it previously was.
- Getting rated will now take more games (usually 4 or 5).
- New ranks:
  - Silverfish (0-499)
  - Slime (500-999)
  - Vex (1000-1299)
  - Evoker (1300-1599)
  - Phantom (1600-1799)
  - Guardian (1800-1999)
  - Warden (2000+)
- Matchmaking now uses an expanding Elo & Rank window, which should make matches slightly more balanced.
  - Queue times will be slightly longer.
  - We will be monitoring and adjusting the queue speed.
- Existing leaderboard is still available [here](https://draftoutmc.com/leaderboard?era=1)!

**Goals**
- Added goals:
  - Obtain Colored Harness
  - Obtain 16 Glow Lichen
  - Use Cartography Table
  - Lock a Map using Cartography Table
  - Break Fishing Rod
  - Break Shield
  - Mine Obsidian
  - Obtain "The Power of Books" advancement
  - (Lobby only) Teleport through Nether Portal using Ender Pearl
- Removed goals (from random goal pool):
  - Visit all Nether Biomes
  - Die to Void

**Gameplay**
- (Quick Play) Added "Rematch" button.
- Standardized more RNG:
  - Leather drops from Cows/Horses/Donkeys/Mules are now shared.
  - Mob held items drop rates (Witch - held potion, Pillager - crossbow etc.).
  - Ore drops are now shared between Deepslate & Stone variants.
  - Seed drops from Grass/Fern blocks are now shared.
- Added progress messages in chat to more goals (foods, breeds, mob kills).

**Lobby**
- Split mode selection into more intuitive toggles
  - Board: Random/Drafted/Custom
  - Teams: Custom/Single
    - Supporters can select each player's team color (and group players into teams - for example 2v2 is now possible).
- Added Seed Type selection (requires Supporter Tier 2).

**Replays**
- You can now zoom in and out of the followed player by holding sneak/jump.
- Updated replay board GUI:
  - shows player's dimension under the time bar
  - goal completions on the progress bar are now clickable
- Fixed some bugs (breath meter ticking, spectator dying in void etc.).

name: Draftout 1.15.1
changelog:
Gameplay
- Disabled mob spawning in Jungle Temples.
- Profiling (using F3+L) in now disabled in matches.

Settings
- Added world clearing options to Utility tab (enabled by default, keeps 20 latest worlds).

Bug fixes
- "Craft X Unique Items" playing the sound on non-unique crafts.
- (Lobby) Some goal completion messages showing the wrong player.
- Replay button not being clickable on some GUI scales.
- Getting stuck on loading screen when opening a replay while in a world.
- (Replays) Pumpkin overlay showing when spectated player was wearing it.

name: Draftout 1.15.0
changelog:
Replays
- You can now view match replays using the Replay system.
    - Download replays from profile -> match screen.
  - Downloaded replays are saved locally (in the "Replays" tab).
- Replay controls are located on the Board Screen.
    - Most controls also have hotkeys.
- Limitations:
    - Replays are only available in Competitive mode.
  - Replays are stored on the server for 24 hours. Downloaded replays can be stored locally and shared as files.

Goals
- Reduced size of icon text (e.g. 50, 64, 100, 400) to fit within the cell.
- Updated some goal icons & names to be more consistent.
- Added goals:
    - Duplicate Allay
  - Duplicate any Armor Trim
  - Obtain 2 Unique Armor Trims
  - Mine 3 types of Ice
  - Wear Full Armor with different materials
- Removed goals:
    - Spy on Enderman
  - Wear Full Leather Armor

Allowed Mods
- Allowed "Retino" mod.
- Allowed "No Chat Restrictions" mod.
- Allowed "No Telemetry" mod.

Bug fixes
- (API) Drafted goals data getting out of sync sometimes (all existing matches have also been fixed).
- (Vanilla bug) 'blockEntities' piechart keeping block entities when changing render distance.

name: Draftout 1.14.0
changelog:
Gameplay:
- Pillager captain spawns are standardized by spawn #
    - Example: 2nd and 15th pillager spawn will be captain for both players
- Added "Toggle Board" hotkey to hide/show the board (unbound by default)
    - Resets every match (you always start with the board visible)

Lobbies:
- Added "Commands" setting
    - Allows up to 10 commands.
   - Commands can be ran when players join the world, or once the match starts.

Goals:
- Added goals:
    - Hang a Hanging Sign
   - Kill Husk
- Removed goals:
    - Kill Parched
- "Kill Witch" now requires either Witch Hut, or Pillager Outpost+Village near spawn.

Bug fixes:
- Tab rarely not showing any players.
- Being able to open containers before match start.
- (Lobby) Not being able to use "Ride Horse" goal on Custom boards.
- (Lobby) Seed change not resetting "Reroll Board" button

name: Draftout 1.13.1
changelog:
**Settings**
- You can now change the primary/secondary color which is used in matches.
    - If both players have the same primary color, one of them will use their secondary color.

**Lobby**
- Worlds with a set seed can not be seed changed.
- Matches with a custom board can not be rerolled.

**Goals**
- Updated "Kill Colored Sheep" goal icons
- "Light a Candle" now works with projectiles on fire.

**Bugfixes**
- Wrong text on post-match screen when playing differently sized boards.
- (Lobby) Seed changing in lobby with a custom board resetting said board.
- (Lobby) Completing custom boards with multiple goals with same id (e.g. "Kill Colored Sheep") not finishing the game.
- (Lobby) Losing lobby owner status after a finished match.

name: Draftout 1.13.0
changelog:
**Gameplay**
- Generated container loot is now based on # of containers open, and not it's location
  - Example: different *first* shipwreck = same loot.
  - This applies to every container with loot (chest, barrel, pots, suspicious blocks etc.).
  - This is **experimental** and may be reverted.
- Updated Settings screen - split into 2 tabs (Board & Connections).
  - Added 2 settings for completed goal color (Opacity & Behind/In Front of icon)
- Updated Birds Eye View: no longer uses Spectator mode, added right click to "Spyglass" zoom.
- "Spectate World" button now enables cheats and /seed works.
- Camel Husk and Zombie Nautilus now count as Hostile mobs (when being ridden by hostiles).

**Messages**
- Added "Messages" screen in-game for:
  - Update changelogs,
  - Warnings,
  - Mutes,
  - System messages

**Lobbies**
- Added Lobby Settings:
  - Time Limit,
  - Overtime,
  - World Seed,
  - Board (Random/Custom) - includes a full Board Builder and Board Size.
- Board Builder allows you to build & set custom boards.
  - You can save & load boards as files.
  - This will be a supporter-only feature in the future.
- Added Seed Change to Draft screen (for lobby owner).

**Goals**
- Changed "Obtain 4 Unique Seeds" to include Nether Wart.
- Changed icon for "Wear Full Armor" goals to include the number 4.
- Changed icon for "Mine" goals to include a pickaxe.

**Bug Fixes**
- Being able to switch to Peaceful mode.
- Rare crash on draft start.
- (Vanilla bug) 'blockEntities' piechart keeping block entities from chunks you died in.

name: Draftout 1.11.1
changelog:
- Fixed bugs:
	- Ghost games (goals not registering)
	- Lava pool rarity applying to most other features
	- Being teleported to surface on rejoin

name: Draftout 1.11.0
changelog:
- Seed filter changes:
    - New seed type: Igloo
		- Always generates with a Basement
	- "No structure" seed type has been changed to "Miscellaneous"
		- Includes either a rare biome (e.g. Mushroom, Pale Garden) or a rare structure (e.g. Trial Ruins, Mansion, Ancient City) in a larger radius.
- During the draft, players can enter a "Birds eye view" which allows you to spectate the world from 30 blocks in the air.
	- Press jump to enter it and sneak to exit.
	- This only works up to 5s before game start.
- Lobbies can be rejoined after a disconnect/crash (5 minutes, same as competitive/quick play).
- Added "Board Scale" setting (50% to 200%, default is 100%).
- Changed guaranteed Ender Pearl trades from 6 trades in 10 gold blocks -> 4 trades in 16 gold blocks.
- Draftout menu can be accessed from pause screen (in servers/worlds).
- Chunks near spawn are loaded in the same order for all players, so features (e.g. trees, water/lava pools) should be standardized (ty @contaria).
	- Leaves are now considered a spawnable block.
	- This is still experimental and we might revert it if there's issues.
- Server connection should be more stable now.
- Removed goals:
	- Enrage Enderman
	- Die to Trident
	- Obtain Dragon Egg
	- Obtain End Rod
	- Eat Chorus Fruit
- Fixed bugs:
	- F1 not hiding the board
	- Being able to move during draft for a few ticks (on rejoin)
